issues.title: No mechanism is available to bypass blocks of content, such as a skip link or landmark regions.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: As a keyboard-only user, I have to tab through every single element before the main content on every page. Without a 'skip link' or proper page structure with landmarks, navigating websites with repeated navigation blocks becomes tedious and time-consuming, creating a significant barrier to accessing the content I need.
remediation_instructions: Add a 'skip to main content' link as the first focusable element on the page that links to the main content container.
Structure the page using HTML5 landmark elements, such as `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, and `<aside>`, to allow assistive technologies to navigate directly to different sections of the page.
expected_tool_change: An automated tool should report the absence of a `<main>` landmark or other page structure mechanisms.
A keyboard navigation test will show that there is no way to skip the navigation and go directly to the main content.
